description: This file defines the ModelFormFieldBuilder class, which constructs instances of ModelFormField for form field configuration in the OFBiz framework. It includes XML parsing logic, field type inference, and methods to merge override configurations.

classes.name: ModelFormFieldBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for constructing ModelFormField instances based on XML definitions or programmatic overrides. It handles field type deduction, XML parsing, and configuration merging to facilitate dynamic form field creation within the OFBiz framework.
